# openwrt_system_ntp (Resource)

NTP client/server settings (`config timeserver`, usually named `ntp`).

Manages a `timeserver` section in `/etc/config/system`. This section normally exists on a stock router: creating the resource adopts it (renaming an anonymous section to `section`), and destroying the resource only removes it from state.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `section` (String) UCI section name. Changing it renames the section in place.

### Optional

- `enable_server` (Boolean) Serve NTP to the LAN. (UCI option `enable_server`.)
- `enabled` (Boolean) Enable the NTP client. (UCI option `enabled`.)
- `extra_lists` (Map of List of String) Additional list options not covered by this resource's attributes. Only listed keys are managed.
- `extra_options` (Map of String) Additional scalar options not covered by this resource's attributes. Only listed keys are managed.
- `interface` (String) Interface to serve NTP on. (UCI option `interface`.)
- `server` (List of String) NTP servers. (UCI option `server`.)
- `use_dhcp` (Boolean) Use NTP servers announced via DHCP. (UCI option `use_dhcp`.)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) `<config>.<section>`.
